payload.title: The tenant default escalation policy has no database integrity: is_default has no unique index and create or update clears every default then saves in a separate non-transactional statement, so a tenant can hold two defaults or none, and with none an unmatched incident is never escalated
evidence: apps/alert-engine/src/escalation/escalation-policy.service.ts:86-95 (all defaults are cleared, then the new policy is saved, outside a transaction)
apps/alert-engine/src/escalation/escalation-policy.service.ts:124-129 (the update path repeats the same two steps)
apps/alert-engine/src/database/migrations/1800000000000-Baseline.ts:16 (is_default boolean with no partial unique index)
apps/alert-engine/src/escalation/escalation-policy.service.ts:195-197 (getDefaultPolicy takes the first isDefault row of the cached list)
apps/alert-engine/src/escalation/escalation-manager.service.ts:275-277 (no policy: a warning is logged and null returned, so the incident is not escalated)
payload.rule_violated: The repo rule ranks impossible above automatic above detectable, so a one-default-per-scope invariant must be impossible to break in the database rather than kept by two unsynchronised statements
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-22, release R6.
